* A character who has been made 'forfeit = 0' can still be forfeited, and therefore, can still be revived.
* The revived character is a 'fresh copy' unaffected by any previously applied status effects such as 'forfeit = 0' or 'game text canceled for remainder of turn'.
* The revived character could even battle again this turn (e.g. by moving to another site with [[Nabrun Leids]] and battling there).
* Can only revive the exact card that was forfeited, not another copy of that card or persona.

A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (11 September 2025). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-oldben-PC-Errata-2025-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Old Ben (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): Same words as the previous version. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2025 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
